evidence_chain_fixes.summary: The LIVE run's reconstruction defect (a BUY with data_confidence=0, feature_as_of=None, blank regime, agreement_ratio=0, P_target=0, P_stop=0, reason_codes=none) was traced to the certification harness hand-building bare DecisionTrace objects that bypassed the populated builder. Root causes fixed, not masked.
fixes: DecisionTrace integrity guard (src/explainability/decision_trace.py): a tradeable BUY/SELL trace with missing PIT timestamps (feature_as_of/data_as_of), non-positive/absent expected net edge, degenerate or out-of-range barrier probabilities, zero data confidence, or empty reason codes is DOWNGRADED to NO_TRADE with EVIDENCE_CHAIN_INCOMPLETE before it can be persisted (mandate §7, §8, §9, §10).

MetaDecisionEngine (src/meta/engine.py) now attaches structured POSITIVE reason codes to tradeable decisions (POSITIVE_EXPECTED_EDGE, MODEL_AGREEMENT, DATA_QUALITY_OK, REGIME_SUPPORT, NEWS_SUPPORT) — previously a BUY could be produced with an empty reason-code list.

Explicit lifecycle states (src/registry/lifecycle.py): champion/shadow now carry champion_status/shadow_status (NOT_EVALUATED | ELIGIBLE | NO_ELIGIBLE_CHAMPION | NO_ELIGIBLE_SHADOW) with a reason, replacing ambiguous null (mandate §12).

Certification harness (scripts/run_certification.py) rewritten: builds fully-populated traces routed through the integrity guard, persists model_version on every record, adds --require-live (hard-fails when data-service2.0 is unavailable, no synthetic fallback), tags every artifact with a data_source_class, relabels the in-process replay loop as HISTORICAL_REPLAY (explicitly NOT forward-paper evidence), and adds an independent-metric cross-check block.

Independent metric recomputation (src/analytics/independent_metrics.py): second-opinion IC/rank-IC/Brier/ECE/net-consistency computed from persisted records; adversarial calibration detector flags a suspicious ECE=0 (constant predictions / too-few-samples / single-populated-bin) — addressing the previously suspicious perfect ECE (mandate §37, §73, §74).
evidence_chain_fixes.verification: Synthetic harness run now yields a COMPLETE reconstruction (data_confidence populated, feature_as_of set, regime present, P_target/P_stop populated, reason codes present) and champion_status=NO_ELIGIBLE_CHAMPION. With the §10 positive-edge guard active, 636/1315 replay decisions correctly downgrade to NO_TRADE.

promotion_decision.reason: Infrastructure + evidence-chain integrity in place and tested. Real-data research EXECUTED across the full staged matrix: daily 3-symbol (NO_SIGNAL), intraday 15m/5m 3-symbol (NO_SIGNAL / ECONOMICALLY_UNVIABLE), AND — with the fno-universe 503 now FIXED — BROAD cross-sectional research on 209–217 real F&O symbols (daily + 15m). The broad daily cross-section shows a real, leakage-clean, independently-reproduced close-to-close rank IC (≈ 0.19), but it COLLAPSES to ≈ 0.02 under next-open execution and is NEGATIVE net Sharpe (-11 to -14) at every cost level — a short-horizon reversal / bid-ask-bounce artifact, ECONOMICALLY_UNVIABLE. NO cost-surviving edge verified on any tested configuration. Stale-data blocking closed; LookAheadGuard wired in live inference; chaos fail-closed verified; latency benchmarked. Production/shadow remain prohibited; genuine forward-paper evidence still absent (infrastructure ready, NOT_RUN).

proxy_backtest_contradiction.finding: The certification backtest reconstructs its price path from the forward triple-barrier label (close = 100·Π(1+realized_return/5)) and uses in-sample fit-and-predict signals. Both are contaminated by future information; the positive proxy P&L is NOT market P&L.
proxy_backtest_contradiction.resolution: Added src/backtest/provenance.py (classify_backtest / assert_not_economic_evidence). The proxy is stamped pnl_provenance=RECONSTRUCTED_PROXY, is_economic_evidence=False, consumed_by_eligibility_gates=False, invariant 'PROXY_BACKTEST != REAL_MARKET_PNL'.
proxy_backtest_contradiction.gate_audit: VERIFIED no shadow/production gate consumes proxy P&L. Shadow eligibility keys only on walk-forward OOS IC / CPCV PBO / walk-forward net Sharpe / calibration ECE; the six promotion gates read held-out validation-partition metrics.

calibration_metric_discrepancy.finding: Reported champion Brier (calibrated preds, held-out last-20% tail, outcome=label>0) diverges from the independent replay Brier (raw in-sample scores, traded signal!=0 rows, outcome=realized_return>0). Divergence is EXPECTED by construction, not a bug.
calibration_metric_discrepancy.resolution: The independent recomputation layer is declared AUTHORITATIVE for verification; the harness annotates the cross-check with divergence_is_expected_by_construction=True and both bases.

drift_attribution.finding: Live-run PSI ≈ 4.51 (CRITICAL/BLOCK) is computed by comparing the reference (full training frame) against frame.tail(200) — a chronological tail of the SAME frame — through equal-frequency reference bins with an eps=1e-10 clamp. On trending/non-stationary features this inflates PSI as a construction artifact.
drift_attribution.resolution: Added attribute_drift() (stationarity self-test: reference early-half vs late-half). On the live run self_test_max_psi≈0.39 already exceeds HIGH → classification = CONSTRUCTION_ARTIFACT_OR_NONSTATIONARITY. Threshold NOT lowered (mandate §50).

universe_expansion.resolution: The fno-universe 503 was root-caused and fixed in data-service2.0 (the endpoint read only a process-local in-memory cache with no DB fallback; the cache was cold after every API restart while a valid ACTIVE snapshot existed in the DB). Added a DB fallback + startup cache-warm + explicit failure semantics (DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE / NO_UNIVERSE / PARTIAL_UNIVERSE / VALID_UNIVERSE). Endpoint now returns HTTP 200.
universe_expansion.survivorship_note: Membership carries a single open effective_from window (bootstrap), NOT point-in-time historical F&O membership; all results below are SURVIVORSHIP_LIMITED and must not be presented as unbiased historical evidence (§11, §54).

daily.primary_metric: cross-sectional Spearman RANK IC (per-timestamp; Pearson IC is outlier-sensitive and used only as a diagnostic, §23/§40/§81)
daily.leakage_check: PASS — null test (shuffle realized within each timestamp) collapses rank IC to ≈ -0.002; forward-return alignment exact.
daily.independent_validation: Rank IC recomputed from 365,153 persisted OOS predictions AGREES EXACTLY with the pipeline value (abs_diff 0.0), §50/§79.
daily.note: The close-to-close rank IC (≈ 0.19) is real, leakage-clean, and reproducible, but it is a short-horizon (1-day) cross-sectional REVERSAL signal (corr(score, ret_1) ≈ -0.5). Close-to-close P&L is NOT valid economic evidence (§32/§33).

real_ohlcv_next_open_backtest.execution: signal at close[T] → ENTER at open[T+1] → EXIT at open[T+1+holding]; no close-to-close fills, no reconstructed price path.
real_ohlcv_next_open_backtest.trade_level_audit: 30-trade sample, 0 violations (signal_ts < entry_ts < exit_ts; net <= gross).
real_ohlcv_next_open_backtest.finding: The close-to-close rank IC of 0.19 COLLAPSES to ≈ 0.02 (noise threshold) under next-open forward returns, and every next-open portfolio configuration has a NEGATIVE gross and net Sharpe at every cost level. The apparent edge was a same-bar close-timing / bid-ask-bounce reversal artifact, not tradeable alpha.

intraday_15m.note: Corroborates daily: no tradeable cross-sectional edge at 15m.

cross_sectional.capacity: NOT_COMPUTED — moot for an economically-unviable signal; presenting a capacity curve for a non-tradeable signal would be misleading (§34).
cross_sectional.conclusion: The central phase question (§108) is ANSWERED for this universe: a broad, liquid, PIT-safe F&O equity universe contains a statistically-detectable cross-sectional rank IC, but it does NOT survive realistic next-open execution or costs. Statistical significance did NOT convert to economic significance. NO VERIFIED EDGE. This extends the prior 5m 'statistically-interesting-but-economically-unviable' finding to a broad universe.
